## Restrictions that are not about kinds

These options safe mode disables gate no term kind. The fragment
is therefore **not expressible as a kind list alone**.

| option | restricts | where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fpExp` | the type | `theory/fp/theory_fp.cpp` |
| | | calls checkForExperimentalFloatingPointType on each term, so the restriction is on the sort, which has kind TYPE_CONSTANT and cannot be excluded by kind |
| `ufHoExp` | the logic | `theory/uf/theory_uf.cpp` |
| | | throws when logicInfo().isHigherOrder() and the option is off, so the restriction is on the declared logic, not on any kind |
